headline: PayPal's treasury AI agent handles $53 billion in cash, per a Deutsche Bank case study
body: A Deutsche Bank case study describes PayPal's treasury operation, which runs on one system with a conversational agent on top. The system handles $53 billion in corporate cash and customer funds. The study credits it with cash visibility across about 1,000 accounts that rose from 78% to nearly 100%, and reports about 1,700 hours saved.
note: The case shows a payments firm moving treasury questions into a chat window, but PayPal has not disclosed how much of the saved time becomes cost savings.

evidence.text: Ask PayPal’s treasury team where its cash sits, and the answer now comes from a chat window.
A Deutsche Bank case study describes how that change unfolded inside the company.
PayPal’s treasury operation now runs on one system with a conversational agent on top, according to the Deutsche Bank case study.
The system handles $53 billion in corporate cash and customer funds, and the team once relied on 90 spreadsheets to track it.
The study credits the system with coverage across 160 currency pairs and cash visibility that rose from 78% to nearly 100% across about 1,000 accounts.
It also reports accuracy above 99% in cash positioning and about 1,700 hours saved.
PayPal has not disclosed how much of that time becomes cost savings.
